jobs.name: 01_日常行驶
jobs.prompt: Create a polished 2D animation keyframe storyboard sheet for ESP-VoCat, a small circular 360x360 screen showing ONLY an expressive digital cat face. Flat pure black background. Consistent mascot in every cell: two large luminous mint-cyan eye shapes with deep black pupils, tiny mint cat w mouth, two short subtle whisker marks each side; no head outline, no body, no device bezel, no scenery, no steering wheel. Restrained warm peach accents only for surprise or affection. Crisp flat clean shapes with very restrained soft edge glow, readable at tiny size, adorable expressive rather than human emoji. Every face is centered inside an imaginary circle with 15% safe margins. Professional sprite animation preproduction. EXACT layout: 4 rows and 4 columns, 16 equal square black cells, thin dark-gray straight separator lines, no gaps. Each ROW is ONE animation with FOUR temporally successive keyframes left to right. Maintain identical eye spacing, mascot proportions, camera scale across sheet except intentional squash/stretch. No captions, NO text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no arrows. Distinct and meaningful successive poses. Output a large square high-resolution image. Row 1 waking up: sleeping eye slits; half open sleepy eyes; wide awake eyes with one tiny sparkle; relaxed open neutral eyes. Row 2 move-off: neutral attentive; anticipating narrower eyes; excited eyes leaning slightly upward with tiny short trails; happy settled smile. Row 3 acceleration: alert; eyes slightly squashed and drifting backward/right; exaggerated delighted squint with short motion ticks; excited rounded eyes. Row 4 steady cruise: relaxed round eyes; slow half blink; fully closed curved happy eyes; same relaxed round eyes. Calm cute clear readable.
